args.title: Salt Marsh returns logistics — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece (https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion):

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, underscoring the scale of the reverse-logistics problem in retail.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (20%).
- Per the companion piece, reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, making speed-to-resale a key lever.
